newsitem.title: USA: Standard Commercial offers $115 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Standard Commercial offers $115 mln in notes.

text.p: Standard Commercial Corp said on Monday its wholly owned subsidiary, Standard Commercial Tobacco Co Inc, has completed a $115 million private placement of 8-7/8 percent Senior Notes due 2005.
In addition, the company said it obtained a commitment of $200 million for a Global Bank Facility.
The company said that through these fundings, in combination with its previously announced $47 million equity offering in May, it has largely completed its refinancing plans.
It will use net proceeds of the funding to repay indebtedness outstanding under existing bank credit facilities and certain long-term debt, the company said.
The Global Bank Facility, in addition to local lines in certain countries, will be used to finance tobacco operations.
The company added that it has not registered the Senior Notes under the Securities Act or applicable state securities laws and therefore may not be offered or sold absent such registration.
Standard Commercial is a major international dealer and processor of leaf tobacco.
